title: Margin Notes
imageAlt: Margin Notes store graphic: select text, right-click or press Alt+Shift+N, then write a labelled note in a small window
description: *Margin Notes* is a **Chrome extension, published on the Chrome Web Store**. Select text on any page, local file, or PDF, right-click or press a shortcut, and add a note labelled Question, Correction, or Rephrasing.
I designed it to proofread content and share feedback. Each page gets its own folder, and its notes export as **Markdown** in one click, ready for a colleague or an **LLM**.
The whole extension weighs **28 KB**, and nothing leaves the browser.
